changes: Payment deletion persists the full invoice/source plan before mutation, reads live paginated relationships, rejects changed relationships and locks, detaches source records with recovery, uses canonical server allocation reconciliation with explicit zeros, and deletes the parent last.

Card payment source status, payment link and audit fields are written together; pending journal keeps recorded source records resumable after lost update responses.
Prepayment request/service sync failures retain a persistent retry action and do not report full completion or create another payment.
Conflicting pending create/edit/delete journals and repeated allocation pages fail closed.
Final payment read checks the direct Accounting_Entry lookup again before deleting the parent. The no-allocation confirmation now explains source unlinking and state updates.

Posted/reconciled payments and existing accounting links block deletion. No accounting entry generation introduced.
Legacy incomplete payment deletions are blocked for review instead of guessing already removed invoice relationships.
